amendment.what_changes: one OPTIONAL environment key, MEDZEN_SCORE_INPUT_CONVENTION; the default and every existing field are unchanged
what_does_not_change: default audio path: resample to 16 kHz + per-utterance z-normalisation via _preprocess_wave, which is byte-unchanged
serving: omnilingual_asr ASRInferencePipeline, which never imports the research evaluator
existing receipts, attestations and reported results
the decode path and model-loading rule
amendment.why: Training feeds raw waveforms (pipeline/omniasr_data.py make_batch_source) while this contract's evaluator and serving normalise each utterance. Whether that mismatch affects trained models cannot be measured without scoring identical recordings both ways, which the -001 contract did not permit.

audio: fetch by manifest URI, mono-mean, resample16k + utterance z-norm (calibrate _preprocess_wave), bfloat16
base_mode_rule: owner decision 2026-08-27: when MEDZEN_SCORE_ARM=='base' the export-weight fetch/load is skipped and the sha-verified STAGED base checkpoint (omniASR-CTC-1B-v2.pt == the pinned MEDZEN_SCORE_MODEL_SHA256) is the model; ALL other arms unchanged (fetch + strict-load their export).
decode: CTC greedy over model logits truncated to the returned seq_len; consecutive-duplicate collapse; blank drop; skip-special decode (calibrate _ctc_greedy_text)
decode_parity_rule: the evaluator IMPORTS _preprocess_wave and _ctc_greedy_text from pipeline.omniasr_calibrate — the exact functions the mandatory in-run upstream-parity probe validates on every calibration; the evaluator adds NO decode logic of its own The raw diagnostic path is likewise imported from pipeline.omniasr_calibrate (_raw_wave); the evaluator still adds no preprocessing or decode logic of its own.
diagnostic_input_convention_rule: MEDZEN_SCORE_INPUT_CONVENTION in {normalized (default), raw}; an unrecognised value refuses. 'raw' feeds the waveform exactly as training does (_raw_wave in pipeline.omniasr_calibrate: float32, mono mean, no resample, no normalisation, refused unless 16 kHz). 'raw' is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: receipts declare input_convention, and scripts/arm2_nomination_scorer.py refuses any receipts whose input_convention is not 'normalized'. Never used for nomination, promotion or serving.
environment_contract: MEDZEN_EXECUTION_MODE=arm2_scoring (strict enum, launcher+trainer parity); MEDZEN_SCORE_* pins injected by the launcher from the reviewed scoring packet
inputs: scoring manifest fetched by EXACT VersionId + sha; identities only + audio locations; the evaluator NEVER sees references
model_loading: stage_model_artifacts (the trainer's own staging step) pulls the base checkpoint to /models BEFORE architecture load; export weights fetched by EXACT S3 VersionId and sha-verified (strict load) — a substituted model refuses
purpose: Frozen decoding contract for the PROTECTED ATTESTED EVALUATOR (Codex final-gap correction item 1): pins the exact decode path, audio preprocessing, model-loading rule and receipts schema BEFORE any candidate hypotheses exist.

receipts_schema.attestation: the workflow's attest mode signs the EXACT receipts bytes with actions/attest-build-provenance (pinned v2.2.3); the scorer verifies the Sigstore bundle cryptographically
receipts_schema.file: {record, job_name, arm, model_sha256, model_artifact{s3_uri,s3_version_id}, training_packet_canonical_sha256, split_sha256, evaluator_image_digest, manifest_sha256, input_convention, rows:[{audio_checksum_sha256, hyp_normalized}]}
receipts_schema.input_convention_rule: present on every receipt from this evaluator version; receipts that predate it are the normalised contract path
